content.short: UniPass is a non-custodial smart contract wallet with no seed phrases or gas fees.
content.description: UniPass enables Web3 applications to onboard Web2 users by providing a non-custodial smart contract wallet that removes the need for seed phrases and gas payments. The project builds wallet SDKs for all major platforms, supporting a broad range of use cases—from Web3 games to loyalty programs such as Starbucks Odyssey—with a focus on frictionless onboarding, security, and accessibility. By simplifying wallet setup and daily use, UniPass aims to accelerate the mass adoption of Web3 across industries and audiences.
